split_scope: Capture-date and undated-camera groups; all data comes from one substation, so this is NOT independent asset or UK validation. Development is not a final test.
selection: One representative per exact-pixel/dHash duplicate component. Quarantine cross-split components. Within split, deterministic SHA256 order, round-robin glass+porcelain / porcelain-only / glass-only / no-target strata. Include three already inspected format-audit images only in development.
annotation_unit: Each original material polygon becomes one clipped bounding box; no merging into strings, no pseudo-labels. Equipment/material polygons can overlap.
checkpoint_selection: Fixed last epoch; no target-driven checkpoint/threshold selection or repeated search.
external_scope: All eight previously inspected UVInsDet demo inputs; never an untouched test. No UK frozen image is read.
execution: One fixed supervised experiment on Roihu gputest only; stop on non-finite loss or budget exhaustion, do not automatically resubmit. Original outputs and failures retained.
